copy.edit-note-range-invert-colors-help: Reflect the five colors inside each seed band, only between the two choices. The middle color stays put. If a destination is held outside the section or beyond the garden, nothing moves. Undo restores the drawing.

sectioninvert.message: sectioninvert preserves unrelated state and answers its supplied native experiment

copy.edit-note-range-triples-help: Count groups of three from the beginning of the chosen section and reverse each group. A final pair reverses too. Notes outside the section stay put; Undo restores the phrase.

sectiontriples.message: sectiontriples preserves unrelated state and answers its supplied native experiment
